title: Clementine | Black Two-Piece with Polka Dot Cuffs
bodyHtml:
Some pieces don't need to shout to be noticed. This striking black co-ord lets the line do the talking, with a playful polka dot detail on the cuffs that catches the light just right. The relaxed tunic skims your frame without clinging, while the wide-leg trousers create an effortlessly lengthening silhouette. Wear it from morning meetings to evening plans—timeless and understated.

Why you'll love it

  • Complete co-ord: tunic and trousers designed as one seamless set
  • Relaxed oversize fit that skims without clinging
  • Rounded neckline—a classic that simply works
  • Polka dot cuffs add personality and visual interest
  • Asymmetric hem brings gentle movement to the hem
  • Wide-leg trousers with a naturally flattering line
  • Versatile black that pairs with everything in your wardrobe

Over 50,000 women have already chosen us, with an average rating of 4.8 out of 5. Your happiness and your trust mean everything to us.
